name: Gomyou Takaaki
source: Gekkai-kai student council vice president. As with his glasses, he looks a little neurotic, and has an annoying and obnoxious personality. Hostile towards the Tendou-kai, he will do anything in order to frame them. He has strong desires, and will openly declare that he is more suited for president than Sera.
